versions.subject: feat: update del related detection (#4046)
versions.detection:
selection:
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' del '
        - /f
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' del '
        - /s
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - rmdir
        - /s
        - /q
condition: selection
versions.spl: (CommandLine="* del *" CommandLine="*/f*") OR (CommandLine="* del *" CommandLine="*/s*") OR (CommandLine="*rmdir*" CommandLine="*/s*" CommandLine="*/q*")

versions.subject: feat: update cmd based rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'Cmd.Exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'rmdir'
        - '/s'
        - '/q'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\cmd.exe" OR OriginalFileName="Cmd.Exe" CommandLine="*rmdir*" CommandLine="*/s*" CommandLine="*/q*"
